downloaded_artifact_reverification.scope: These downloaded-artifact checks rerun only Python byte, metadata, scalar PSF convolution, rectangular-overlap, QE/spectral expected-charge, deterministic/observable-readout and repeat comparisons. They do not rerun Octave/MATLAB numerical processes or generate demos, reproduce random streams, authenticate unobserved physics/RNG history or ISET input generation, or independently prove original CI process independence and dependency cleanliness. Original execution/runtime and cleanliness remain retained CI evidence.

retention_totals.scope_note: Counts exclude this catalog, the explanatory Markdown note, historical baseline evidence, and mutable completion/review documents. The 3 original recheck stdout receipts are among supporting records.

limitations: Native MATLAB was not executed; numerical acceptance is scoped to GNU Octave 9.4.0 locally and 8.4.0 in CI.
Same-runtime repeated demos are byte-identical; no cross-runtime random-stream identity is claimed.

This independent synthetic research model is uncalibrated. Published geometry does not establish total die dimensions, hardware crop origins, measured CFA/QE/PSF/noise, measured 17-stop performance or genuine ARRIRAW.

The ISETCam comparison covers the declared restricted fixtures, not arbitrary optical-image imports or measured ARRI optics; ISETHdrsensor remains pinned but is not executed by the current readout model.

Downloaded-artifact Python rechecks validate bytes and scalar associations without rerunning the original Octave/ISET processes, reproducing random streams or authenticating unobserved input generation.
The original Python executable paths are retained, but exact original interpreter versions were not recorded. The later local recheck records its own CPython 3.12.14 runtime.

The full CI archive has 14-day retention and recorded expiry; all binary demo payloads and raw CI API/job-log observation inputs are not retained in Git. The versioned selection preserves original reports/logs and complete receipt inventories.
Practical full-frame memory and throughput remain unestablished.
